ei.title: Why Fashion Needs to Be More Sustainable
ei.subject: 공통영어1

fullPassage:
Why Fashion Needs to Be More Sustainable

Jessi is a fashion blogger who loves unique, vibrant clothes. But guess what? She does not buy new clothes. Instead, she buys them secondhand. You may think secondhand clothes are old-fashioned, but by buying them, Jessi can try different styles. She also does not get too attached to any style or brand because there is always another exciting outfit waiting to be discovered. Jessi's clothing habits are not just about creating a style; they are about saving the Earth. The reason is that her actions help reduce the production and consumption of clothes.

Worth over $3 trillion and making up 2% of the world's GDP, the fashion industry today has an almost entirely linear approach. The process moves in a straight line from design to consumption to disposal. Material extraction, textile manufacturing, the supply chain, design, sales, marketing, and other steps are guided by the aim of maximizing garment consumption without considering other issues. Due to linear fashion, the fashion industry negatively affects the environment. 85% of textiles go into landfills, only 1% of the materials is recycled, at least 500,000 tons of microfibers end up in the ocean (equal to 50 billion plastic bottles), and 93 billion cubic meters of water is required for textile production annually. Alarming numbers like these will keep increasing if producers maintain the old system. It is clear that waste and pollution from the fashion industry must be reduced. Linear fashion must change, and this could happen through circular fashion.

Circular fashion is inspired by the principles of a circular economy and sustainable development. A circular economy is based on limiting waste, keeping resources and materials in use, and reusing them. In a circular model, we make, use, and reuse materials for as long as possible to extract their maximum value. Therefore, clothing and textiles are produced, used, and reused to minimize waste. It is a renewable approach to reduce the fashion industry's environmental impact. Circular fashion provides numerous benefits. First, extending the lifespan of fibers significantly reduces textile waste, benefiting the environment. Second, circular processes utilize chemicals and materials safe for human health and the environment. This practice protects the environment and consumer health. Third, materials are regenerated instead of being disposed of, which enables their long-term use.

The rise of circular fashion is facilitated by new technology and ideas. Materials commonly used in clothing are not eco-friendly because they require considerable resources and often break down slowly. This creates a need for eco-friendly textile alternatives. Currently, companies are developing recycled fibers and fibers extracted from agricultural waste products like leaves, peels, and seeds. One company uses nanotechnology to make soft material from orange peels. Another makes fabrics from kapok tree seeds. The trees grow well in poor soil without needing much water. These new fabrics produce less waste, last a long time, and break down easily.

In addition to these manufacturing techniques, technology will improve in such a way that it may become normal to produce clothes only when people order them. This "make-to-order" method will cost more, but then less money will be spent on maintaining offline stores. And 3D technology will enable people to see how clothes will fit online without trying them on in a store. In the long run, innovation in production and sales will facilitate sustainable fashion and considerably reduce material waste and logistics emissions.

Another key to making fashion sustainable is the consumer: us. If we want the fashion industry to adopt more sustainable practices, we must care about how clothes come to us. We should then demonstrate our concerns through what we buy. The market, of course, will respond. We can also reduce waste by discarding clothes responsibly. To be specific, we should buy only what we need and pass clothing on to someone who will wear it or to a thrift shop when discarding it.

Circular fashion will not solve every problem in the fashion industry overnight. However, small steps in the right direction are better than nothing. Keeping things in the supply chain for as many cycles as possible is really important. By making small changes to our clothing habits today, the fashion industry will gradually improve. After all, nothing is more fashionable than saving the planet.

questions.passage: Jessi is a fashion blogger who loves unique, vibrant clothes.  But guess what?  She does not buy new clothes.  Instead, she buys them secondhand.  You may think secondhand clothes are old-fashioned, but by ①<u>buying</u> them, Jessi can try different styles.  She also does not get too attached to any style or brand because there is always another exciting outfit ②<u>waited</u> to be discovered.  Jessi's clothing habits are not just about ③<u>creating</u> a style; they are about saving the Earth.  The reason is that her actions help ④<u>reduce</u> the production and consumption of clothes.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: buying(사는 것), waited→waiting(기다리는), creating(만드는), reduce(줄이다). 명사를 수식하는 분사가 능동이면 현재분사(-ing)를 써야 한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① buying (사는 것)
→ 전치사 by 뒤에 동명사(-ing)가 오는 것은 정상. 'by buying them'은 '그것들을 사는 것으로써'라는 수단 표현.

❌ ② waited (기다렸던) ←정답
→ 원문은 waiting. 'outfit waiting to be discovered'에서 outfit(옷)은 발견되기를 '기다리는' 주체이므로 능동 의미의 현재분사 waiting이 필요. waited(과거분사)는 수동 의미로 문맥에 맞지 않음.

✅ ③ creating (만드는 것)
→ 전치사 about 뒤에 동명사(-ing)가 오는 것은 정상. 'about creating a style'은 '스타일을 만드는 것에 대해'라는 의미.

✅ ④ reduce (줄이다)
→ help + 동사원형 구문으로 정상. 'help reduce the production'은 '생산을 줄이는 것을 돕다'라는 의미.
det.tip: 명사 수식 분사 구별법: 능동(~하는) → 현재분사(-ing), 수동(~된/~당한) → 과거분사(-ed). outfit은 '기다리는' 주체이므로 waiting.

questions.passage: Worth over $3 trillion and making up 2% of the world's GDP, the fashion industry today has an almost entirely linear approach.  The process moves in a straight line from design to consumption to disposal.  Material extraction, textile manufacturing, the supply chain, design, sales, marketing, and other steps ①<u>are guided</u> by the aim of maximizing garment consumption without ②<u>considered</u> other issues.  Due to linear fashion, the fashion industry negatively affects the environment.  85% of textiles go into landfills, only 1% of the materials is recycled, at least 500,000 tons of microfibers end up in the ocean, and 93 billion cubic meters of water ③<u>is</u> required for textile production annually.  Alarming numbers like these will keep ④<u>increasing</u> if producers maintain the old system.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: are guided(이끌리다), considered→considering(고려하면서), is(~이다), increasing(증가하는). 전치사 뒤에는 반드시 동명사(-ing)가 와야 한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① are guided (이끌리다)
→ 'steps are guided by the aim'에서 주어 steps(복수)에 맞는 수동태(are guided). 목적에 의해 '이끌린다'는 수동 의미로 정상.

❌ ② considered (고려된) ←정답
→ 원문은 considering. 전치사 without 뒤에는 동명사(-ing)만 올 수 있다. 'without considering other issues'는 '다른 문제를 고려하지 않고'라는 의미. considered(과거분사)는 전치사 뒤에 올 수 없으므로 어법상 틀림.

✅ ③ is (이다)
→ '93 billion cubic meters of water is required'에서 핵심 명사는 불가산 명사 water. 'A of B' 구조에서 수 일치는 핵심 명사(water) 기준이므로 단수 is가 정상.

✅ ④ increasing (증가하는)
→ 'will keep increasing'에서 keep + 동명사(-ing) 구문으로 '계속 증가할 것이다'라는 의미. 정상.
det.tip: 전치사(without, by, of, in 등) 뒤 → 동명사(-ing)만 가능. 과거분사(-ed) 불가.

questions.passage:
Circular fashion provides numerous benefits.  First, ①<u>extending</u> the lifespan of fibers significantly reduces textile waste, benefiting the environment.  Second, circular processes utilize chemicals and materials ②<u>safe</u> for human health and the environment.  This practice protects the environment and consumer health.  Third, materials are regenerated instead of ③<u>being disposed</u> of, ④<u>that</u> enables their long-term use.

The rise of circular fashion is facilitated by new technology and ideas.  Materials commonly used in clothing are not eco-friendly because they require considerable resources and often break down slowly.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: extending(연장하는 것), safe(안전한), being disposed(폐기되는 것), that→which(계속적 용법). 콤마 뒤 관계대명사는 which만 가능하고 that은 불가하다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① extending (연장하는 것)
→ 'Extending the lifespan of fibers significantly reduces...'에서 동명사구가 주어 역할. '섬유의 수명을 연장하는 것이 줄인다'로 정상.

✅ ② safe (안전한)
→ 'chemicals and materials safe for human health'에서 형용사 safe가 명사 뒤에서 후치수식. '인체 건강에 안전한 화학물질과 재료'로 정상.

✅ ③ being disposed (폐기되는 것)
→ 'instead of being disposed of'에서 전치사 instead of 뒤에 동명사 수동형(being + p.p.)이 온 구문. '폐기되는 대신에'로 정상.

❌ ④ that ←정답
→ 원문은 which. 콤마(,) 뒤에 오는 계속적 용법의 관계대명사는 which만 가능하다. that은 계속적 용법(비제한적 용법)에 절대 쓸 수 없다. 선행사는 앞 절 전체('재료가 폐기 대신 재생된다는 것')이며, which enables their long-term use는 '그것이 장기 사용을 가능하게 한다'는 부가 설명.
det.tip: 계속적 용법(, + 관계대명사) = which/who/whom만 가능. that 불가. 선행사가 앞 절 전체일 때도 , which 사용.

questions.passage: Circular fashion is inspired by the principles of a circular economy and sustainable development.  A circular economy is based on ①<u>limiting</u> waste, keeping resources and materials in use, and reusing them.  In a circular model, we make, use, and reuse materials for as long as possible to extract their maximum value.  Therefore, clothing and textiles are produced, used, and reused to ②<u>maximize</u> waste.  It is a renewable approach to reduce the fashion industry's environmental impact.  Circular fashion provides numerous benefits.  First, extending the lifespan of fibers significantly reduces textile waste, ③<u>benefiting</u> the environment.  Second, circular processes utilize chemicals and materials ④<u>safe</u> for human health and the environment.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: limiting(제한하는), maximize→minimize(최소화하다), benefiting(이로운), safe(안전한). 순환 패션의 핵심 목적은 폐기물 최소화(minimize)이다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① limiting (제한하는)
→ 본문: 'A circular economy is based on limiting waste'
→ 폐기물을 '제한하는' 것이 순환 경제의 기반. 문맥상 적절.

❌ ② maximize (극대화하다) ←정답
→ 본문: 원문은 minimize. 'clothing and textiles are produced, used, and reused to minimize waste'에서 순환 모델의 목적은 폐기물 '최소화(minimize)'이다. maximize(극대화)는 정반대 의미로 문맥에 부적절.

✅ ③ benefiting (이로운)
→ 본문: 'extending the lifespan of fibers significantly reduces textile waste, benefiting the environment'
→ 환경에 '이로운' 결과를 가져온다는 의미로 문맥상 적절.

✅ ④ safe (안전한)
→ 본문: 'chemicals and materials safe for human health and the environment'
→ 인체 건강과 환경에 '안전한' 재료라는 의미로 문맥상 적절.
det.tip: minimize(최소화하다) ↔ maximize(극대화하다). 순환 패션 = 폐기물 최소화가 목적.

questions.passage:
In addition to these manufacturing techniques, technology will improve in such a way that it may become normal to produce clothes only when people order them.  This "make-to-order" method will cost more, but then less money will be spent on ①<u>maintaining</u> offline stores.  And 3D technology will enable people to see how clothes will fit online without trying them on in a store.  In the long run, innovation in production and sales will ②<u>facilitate</u> sustainable fashion and considerably ③<u>reduce</u> material waste and logistics emissions.

Another key to making fashion sustainable is the consumer: us.  If we want the fashion industry to adopt more sustainable practices, we must ④<u>ignore</u> how clothes come to us.  We should then demonstrate our concerns through what we buy.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: maintaining(유지하는), facilitate(촉진하다), reduce(줄이다), ignore→care about(관심을 갖다). 소비자는 옷이 오는 과정에 관심을 가져야 한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① maintaining (유지하는)
→ 본문: 'less money will be spent on maintaining offline stores'
→ 오프라인 매장을 '유지하는' 비용이 줄어든다는 맥락. 문맥상 적절.

✅ ② facilitate (촉진하다)
→ 본문: 'innovation in production and sales will facilitate sustainable fashion'
→ 혁신이 지속 가능한 패션을 '촉진할' 것이라는 맥락. 문맥상 적절.

✅ ③ reduce (줄이다)
→ 본문: 'considerably reduce material waste and logistics emissions'
→ 재료 낭비와 물류 배출을 상당히 '줄일' 것이라는 맥락. 문맥상 적절.

❌ ④ ignore (무시하다) ←정답
→ 본문: 원문은 care about. 'we must care about how clothes come to us'에서 소비자는 옷이 어떻게 오는지에 '관심을 가져야 한다'고 주장. ignore(무시하다)는 정반대 의미로 문맥에 부적절.
det.tip: care about(관심을 갖다) ↔ ignore(무시하다). 지속가능한 패션의 핵심 = 소비자의 관심과 참여.

questions.passage: Worth over $3 trillion and making up 2% of the world's GDP, the fashion industry today has an almost entirely linear approach.  The process moves in a straight line from design to consumption to disposal.  Material extraction, textile manufacturing, the supply chain, design, sales, marketing, and other steps are guided by the aim of maximizing garment consumption without considering other issues.  Due to linear fashion, the fashion industry negatively affects the environment.  It is clear that waste and pollution from the fashion industry must be reduced.  Linear fashion must change, and this could happen through ____________.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 선형 패션(linear fashion)의 환경 문제를 해결할 대안으로 순환 패션(circular fashion)을 제시하는 글. 빈칸은 글의 결론부에서 해결책을 묻는다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① circular fashion ←정답
(순환 패션)
→ 본문: 'Linear fashion must change, and this could happen through circular fashion.'
→ 선형 패션이 변해야 하며 그것이 순환 패션을 통해 가능하다는 원문 그대로의 표현. 글 전체가 linear → circular 전환을 주장.

❌ ② digital innovation
(디지털 혁신)
→ 본문에서 기술 발전(3D, nanotechnology)은 후반부에 언급되지만, 빈칸이 있는 단락의 핵심 주장은 '패션 산업 모델의 전환'이지 디지털 혁신이 아님.

❌ ③ economic reform
(경제 개혁)
→ GDP 2%라는 경제 규모 언급은 있으나, 해결책으로 경제 개혁을 제시하지 않음. 패션 산업 내부의 구조 전환이 핵심.

❌ ④ global cooperation
(국제 협력)
→ 국제 협력은 본문에서 전혀 언급되지 않음. 해결 주체는 산업 모델과 소비자.
det.tip: linear fashion(직선형 = 생산→소비→폐기) ↔ circular fashion(순환형 = 생산→사용→재사용). 대안 = circular.

questions.passage: Another key to making fashion sustainable is the consumer: us.  If we want the fashion industry to adopt more sustainable practices, we must care about how clothes come to us.  We should then demonstrate our concerns through what we buy.  The market, of course, will respond.  We can also reduce waste by discarding clothes responsibly.  To be specific, we should buy only what we need and pass clothing on to someone who will wear it or to ____________ when discarding it.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 옷을 책임감 있게 버리는 방법: 입을 사람에게 넘기거나 중고품 가게(thrift shop)에 전달해야 한다. 빈칸은 'pass clothing on to'의 목적지를 묻는다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① a fashion designer
(패션 디자이너)
→ 옷을 디자이너에게 전달한다는 내용은 본문에 없음. 폐기 방법과 무관.

❌ ② a textile factory
(직물 공장)
→ 직물 공장에 옷을 보낸다는 내용은 본문에 없음. 재활용 과정이 아닌 소비자의 실천 방법을 묻는 문맥.

✅ ③ a thrift shop ←정답
(중고품 가게)
→ 본문: 'pass clothing on to someone who will wear it or to a thrift shop when discarding it.'
→ 옷을 버릴 때 입을 사람 또는 중고품 가게에 전달하라는 원문 그대로의 표현.

❌ ④ a recycling center
(재활용 센터)
→ 재활용 관련 내용은 있지만, 이 문단에서 소비자의 구체적 실천으로 제시된 것은 thrift shop이지 recycling center가 아님.
det.tip: thrift shop = 중고품 가게 = secondhand store. 'discard responsibly'의 구체적 실천 방법.

questions.passage: Jessi is a fashion blogger who loves unique, vibrant clothes.  But guess what?  She does not buy new clothes.  Instead, she buys them secondhand.  You may think secondhand clothes are old-fashioned, but by buying them, Jessi can try different styles.  She also does not get too attached to any style or brand because there is always another exciting outfit waiting to be discovered.  Jessi's clothing habits are not just about creating a style; they are about saving the Earth.  The reason is that her actions help reduce the production and consumption of clothes.
questions.stem: 위 글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?

det.korean: 제시(Jessi)의 중고 옷 구매 습관은 스타일 창조(creating a style)뿐 아니라 지구 보호(saving the Earth)를 위한 것이다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① 제시의 옷 습관은 스타일 창조와 지구 보호 모두를 위한 것이다. ←정답
→ 본문: 'Jessi's clothing habits are not just about creating a style; they are about saving the Earth.'
→ 스타일뿐 아니라 지구 보호도 목적이라는 내용과 정확히 일치.

❌ ② 제시는 최신 유행의 새 옷을 구매하여 스타일을 완성한다.
→ 본문: 'She does not buy new clothes. Instead, she buys them secondhand.'
→ 새 옷을 사지 않고 중고를 산다고 명시. '최신 유행의 새 옷'은 본문과 반대.

❌ ③ 제시는 특정 브랜드에 대한 강한 애착으로 유명하다.
→ 본문: 'She also does not get too attached to any style or brand'
→ 특정 스타일이나 브랜드에 집착하지 않는다고 명시. 정반대 내용.

❌ ④ 제시의 행동은 옷의 생산과 소비를 증가시키는 데 기여한다.
→ 본문: 'her actions help reduce the production and consumption of clothes.'
→ 줄이는(reduce) 것이지 증가시키는 것이 아님. 정반대 표현.
det.tip: not just about A; they are about B = A만이 아니라 B이기도 하다. 두 가지 목적을 동시에 제시하는 구문.

ch: 제시의 옷 습관은 스타일 창조와 지구 보호 모두를 위한 것이다.
제시는 최신 유행의 새 옷을 구매하여 스타일을 완성한다.
제시는 특정 브랜드에 대한 강한 애착으로 유명하다.
제시의 행동은 옷의 생산과 소비를 증가시키는 데 기여한다.

questions.passage: The rise of circular fashion is facilitated by new technology and ideas.  Materials commonly used in clothing are not eco-friendly because they require considerable resources and often break down slowly.  This creates a need for eco-friendly textile alternatives.  Currently, companies are developing recycled fibers and fibers extracted from agricultural waste products like leaves, peels, and seeds.  One company uses nanotechnology to make soft material from orange peels.  Another makes fabrics from kapok tree seeds.  The trees grow well in poor soil without needing much water.  These new fabrics produce less waste, last a long time, and break down easily.
questions.stem: 위 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?

det.korean: 카폭 나무(kapok tree)는 척박한 토양(poor soil)에서 물을 많이 필요로 하지 않고(without needing much water) 잘 자란다. '비옥한 토양 + 충분한 물'은 본문과 정반대.
det.analysis:
❌ ① 의류에 흔히 사용되는 재료는 상당한 자원을 필요로 한다.
→ 본문: 'Materials commonly used in clothing... require considerable resources'
→ '상당한 자원(considerable resources)을 필요로 한다'는 원문과 일치.

❌ ② 기업들은 농업 폐기물에서 추출한 섬유를 개발 중이다.
→ 본문: 'companies are developing... fibers extracted from agricultural waste products like leaves, peels, and seeds'
→ 잎, 껍질, 씨앗 같은 농업 폐기물에서 추출한 섬유를 개발 중이라는 원문과 일치.

✅ ③ 카폭 나무는 비옥한 토양과 충분한 물이 있어야 잘 자란다. ←정답
→ 본문: 'The trees grow well in poor soil without needing much water.'
→ 척박한 토양(poor soil)에서 물을 많이 필요로 하지 않고(without needing much water) 자란다고 명시. '비옥한 토양 + 충분한 물'은 정반대.

❌ ④ 새로운 직물들은 폐기물을 적게 생산하고 오래 지속된다.
→ 본문: 'These new fabrics produce less waste, last a long time, and break down easily.'
→ 폐기물 적게 생산 + 오래 지속이라는 원문과 일치.
det.tip: poor soil = 척박한/메마른 토양 (비옥한 토양의 반대). without needing much water = 물이 많이 필요 없이.

ch: 의류에 흔히 사용되는 재료는 상당한 자원을 필요로 한다.
기업들은 농업 폐기물에서 추출한 섬유를 개발 중이다.
카폭 나무는 비옥한 토양과 충분한 물이 있어야 잘 자란다.
새로운 직물들은 폐기물을 적게 생산하고 오래 지속된다.

questions.passage:
In addition to these manufacturing techniques, technology will improve in such a way that it may become normal to produce clothes only when people order them.  This "make-to-order" method will cost more, but then less money will be spent on maintaining offline stores.  And 3D technology will enable people to see how clothes will fit online without trying them on in a store.  In the long run, innovation in production and sales will facilitate sustainable fashion and considerably reduce material waste and logistics emissions.

Another key to making fashion sustainable is the consumer: us.  If we want the fashion industry to adopt more sustainable practices, we must care about how clothes come to us.  We should then demonstrate our concerns through what we buy.
questions.stem: 위 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?

det.korean: 혁신은 물류 배출(logistics emissions)을 상당히 줄인다(considerably reduce)고 했으므로, '증가시킬 것이다'는 본문과 반대이다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① 주문 제작 방식은 기존보다 비용이 더 든다.
→ 본문: 'This "make-to-order" method will cost more'
→ 주문 제작 방식이 더 비용이 든다는 원문과 일치.

❌ ② 오프라인 매장 유지에 드는 비용은 줄어들 것이다.
→ 본문: 'less money will be spent on maintaining offline stores'
→ 오프라인 매장 유지 비용이 줄어든다는 원문과 일치.

✅ ③ 생산과 판매의 혁신은 물류 배출을 증가시킬 것이다. ←정답
→ 본문: 'innovation in production and sales will... considerably reduce material waste and logistics emissions'
→ 혁신이 물류 배출을 '상당히 줄인다(considerably reduce)'고 했으므로 '증가시킬 것이다'는 정반대. 불일치.

❌ ④ 소비자는 옷이 어떻게 오는지에 관심을 가져야 한다.
→ 본문: 'we must care about how clothes come to us'
→ 옷이 오는 과정에 관심을 가져야 한다는 원문과 일치.
det.tip: considerably reduce = 상당히 줄이다. logistics emissions = 물류 과정에서 발생하는 탄소 배출.

ch: 주문 제작 방식은 기존보다 비용이 더 든다.
오프라인 매장 유지에 드는 비용은 줄어들 것이다.
생산과 판매의 혁신은 물류 배출을 증가시킬 것이다.
소비자는 옷이 어떻게 오는지에 관심을 가져야 한다.

questions.passage:
Jessi is a fashion blogger who loves unique, vibrant clothes.  But guess what?  She does not buy new clothes.  Instead, she buys them secondhand.  Jessi's clothing habits are not just about creating a style; they are about saving the Earth.  The reason is that her actions help reduce the production and consumption of clothes.

Worth over $3 trillion and making up 2% of the world's GDP, the fashion industry today has an almost entirely linear approach.  Due to linear fashion, the fashion industry negatively affects the environment.  It is clear that waste and pollution from the fashion industry must be reduced.  Linear fashion must change, and this could happen through circular fashion.

Circular fashion is inspired by the principles of a circular economy and sustainable development.  A circular economy is based on limiting waste, keeping resources and materials in use, and reusing them.  It is a renewable approach to reduce the fashion industry's environmental impact.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 선형 패션(linear fashion)이 환경에 미치는 부정적 영향을 제시하고, 순환 패션(circular fashion)을 통한 해결 필요성을 주장하는 글이다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① the economic value of the secondhand clothing market
(중고 의류 시장의 경제적 가치)
→ 제시의 중고 의류 구매는 도입부 예시일 뿐, 중고 시장의 경제적 가치는 글의 주제가 아님.

✅ ② the need for circular fashion to address environmental issues in the fashion industry ←정답
(패션 산업의 환경 문제를 해결하기 위한 순환 패션의 필요성)
→ 근거: 글 전체 구조가 '선형 패션의 환경 문제(85% 매립, 1% 재활용 등) → 해결책으로 순환 패션 제시 → 구체적 이점 설명'으로 전개. 제목 'Why Fashion Needs to Be More Sustainable'과도 정확히 일치.

❌ ③ how fashion bloggers influence consumer purchasing decisions
(패션 블로거가 소비자 구매 결정에 미치는 영향)
→ 제시(Jessi) 이야기는 글의 도입부 예시로만 사용. 블로거의 영향력은 글의 핵심 주제가 아님.

❌ ④ the role of government regulations in reducing textile waste
(직물 폐기물 감소에서 정부 규제의 역할)
→ 정부 규제는 본문에서 전혀 언급되지 않음. 해결 주체는 산업 모델 전환과 소비자.
det.tip: 글의 주제 = 제목과 일치 여부 확인. 'Why Fashion Needs to Be More Sustainable' = 순환 패션의 필요성.

ch: the economic value of the secondhand clothing market
the need for circular fashion to address environmental issues in the fashion industry
how fashion bloggers influence consumer purchasing decisions
the role of government regulations in reducing textile waste

questions.passage:
Another key to making fashion sustainable is the consumer: us.  If we want the fashion industry to adopt more sustainable practices, we must care about how clothes come to us.  We should then demonstrate our concerns through what we buy.  The market, of course, will respond.  We can also reduce waste by discarding clothes responsibly.  To be specific, we should buy only what we need and pass clothing on to someone who will wear it or to a thrift shop when discarding it.

Circular fashion will not solve every problem in the fashion industry overnight.  However, small steps in the right direction are better than nothing.  Keeping things in the supply chain for as many cycles as possible is really important.  By making small changes to our clothing habits today, the fashion industry will gradually improve.  After all, nothing is more fashionable than saving the planet.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 요지로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 소비자가 의식적 구매(conscious purchasing)와 책임 있는 폐기(responsible disposal)를 실천하면 패션 산업이 점진적으로 개선된다는 것이 요지이다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① Circular fashion can immediately solve all environmental problems in the industry.
(순환 패션이 산업의 모든 환경 문제를 즉시 해결할 수 있다.)
→ 본문: 'Circular fashion will not solve every problem in the fashion industry overnight.'
→ '하룻밤에 모든 문제를 해결하지는 못한다'고 명시. '즉시 해결'은 정반대.

❌ ② Consumers should prioritize buying the most affordable clothing options available.
(소비자는 가장 저렴한 의류를 우선적으로 구매해야 한다.)
→ 본문: 'we should buy only what we need'
→ 기준은 가격(affordable)이 아니라 필요성(what we need). 가격 중심 구매를 주장하지 않음.

✅ ③ Consumers can drive sustainable change in fashion through conscious purchasing and responsible disposal habits. ←정답
(소비자는 의식적 구매와 책임 있는 폐기 습관을 통해 패션의 지속 가능한 변화를 이끌 수 있다.)
→ 근거: 'demonstrate our concerns through what we buy'(의식적 구매) + 'discarding clothes responsibly'(책임 있는 폐기) + 'By making small changes... the fashion industry will gradually improve'(점진적 개선).

❌ ④ The fashion industry will improve only when companies invest in advanced manufacturing technology.
(패션 산업은 기업이 첨단 제조 기술에 투자할 때만 개선될 것이다.)
→ 본문: 'Another key to making fashion sustainable is the consumer: us.'
→ 이 단락의 핵심은 소비자의 역할. 기업의 기술 투자만으로는 부족하다는 맥락.
det.tip: 요지 = 소비자의 의식적 구매 + 책임 있는 폐기 → 점진적 산업 개선. 핵심 키워드: demonstrate concerns, buy only what we need, discard responsibly.

ch: Circular fashion can immediately solve all environmental problems in the industry.
Consumers should prioritize buying the most affordable clothing options available.
Consumers can drive sustainable change in fashion through conscious purchasing and responsible disposal habits.
The fashion industry will improve only when companies invest in advanced manufacturing technology.

questions.passage: Circular fashion will not solve every problem in the fashion industry overnight.  However, small steps in the right direction are better than nothing.  Keeping things in the supply chain for as many cycles as possible is really important.  By making small changes to our clothing habits today, the fashion industry will gradually improve.  After all, <u>nothing is more fashionable than saving the planet</u>.

overlay.underline: nothing is more fashionable than saving the planet

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 "nothing is more fashionable than saving the planet"이 이 문맥에서 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: '지구를 구하는 것보다 더 유행에 맞는 것은 없다'에서 fashionable은 단순히 '유행하는'이 아니라 '가장 가치 있고 존경할 만한'이라는 비유적 의미로 사용되었다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① Wearing eco-friendly clothing is the latest fashion trend.
(친환경 의류를 입는 것이 최신 패션 트렌드이다.)
→ fashionable을 '유행하는'으로 문자적 해석한 표면적 의미. 글의 결론은 패션 트렌드가 아니라 환경 보호의 가치를 말하고 있음.

❌ ② People who save the planet are always well-dressed.
(지구를 구하는 사람들은 항상 옷을 잘 입는다.)
→ 옷과 외모에 대한 문자적 해석으로 비유의 본질을 놓침. fashionable ≠ well-dressed.

✅ ③ Protecting the environment is the most worthwhile and admirable thing one can do. ←정답
(환경을 보호하는 것이 할 수 있는 가장 가치 있고 존경할 만한 일이다.)
→ 근거: fashionable을 '가치 있는/바람직한'으로 재정의. 패션에 관한 글의 결론에서 '패션(fashion)'의 의미를 환경 보호의 가치로 전환한 비유적 표현. 'nothing is more ~ than'은 최상급 강조 구문.

❌ ④ The fashion industry will eventually become completely sustainable.
(패션 산업은 결국 완전히 지속 가능해질 것이다.)
→ 미래 예측이 아닌 현재의 가치 판단 표현. '더 유행에 맞는 것은 없다'는 당위/가치의 표현이지 미래 산업 전망이 아님.
det.tip: nothing is more A than B = B보다 더 A한 것은 없다 (= B가 가장 A하다). fashionable = 문맥에서 '가치 있는/바람직한'으로 재정의.

ch: Wearing eco-friendly clothing is the latest fashion trend.
People who save the planet are always well-dressed.
Protecting the environment is the most worthwhile and admirable thing one can do.
The fashion industry will eventually become completely sustainable.

questions.passage: Circular fashion is inspired by the principles of a circular economy and sustainable development.  A circular economy is based on limiting waste, keeping resources and materials in use, and reusing <u>them</u>.  In a circular model, we make, use, and reuse materials for as long as possible to extract their maximum value.  Therefore, clothing and textiles are produced, used, and reused to minimize waste.  It is a renewable approach to reduce the fashion industry's environmental impact.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 them이 가리키는 것은?

det.korean: 순환 경제(circular economy)는 자원과 재료(resources and materials)를 계속 사용하고 재사용하는 것에 기반한다. them은 바로 앞의 resources and materials를 가리킨다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① 폐기물
→ 본문: 'limiting waste, keeping resources and materials in use, and reusing them'
→ waste는 limiting의 대상이지, reusing의 대상이 아님. '폐기물을 재사용한다'는 맥락이 아니라 '자원과 재료를 재사용한다'는 맥락.

✅ ② 자원과 재료 ←정답
→ 본문: 'keeping resources and materials in use, and reusing them'
→ them은 바로 앞의 명사구 resources and materials를 받는 대명사. '자원과 재료를 사용 상태로 유지하고, 그것들을 재사용한다'는 의미.

❌ ③ 순환 경제의 원리
→ 본문: 'inspired by the principles of a circular economy'
→ 원리(principles)는 영감의 원천이지 재사용의 대상이 아님. '원리를 재사용한다'는 의미가 성립하지 않음.

❌ ④ 옷과 직물
→ 본문: 'clothing and textiles are produced, used, and reused'
→ 옷과 직물은 다음 문장에서 별도로 등장하는 개념. them이 가리키는 것은 같은 문장 내의 resources and materials.
det.tip: 대명사 them의 선행사 찾기: 같은 문장에서 가장 가까운 복수 명사구를 찾는다. keeping [resources and materials] in use, and reusing [them].

questions.passage: Materials commonly used in clothing are not eco-friendly because they require considerable resources and often break down slowly.  This creates a need for eco-friendly textile alternatives.  Currently, companies are developing recycled fibers and fibers extracted from agricultural waste products like leaves, peels, and seeds.  One company uses nanotechnology to make soft material from orange peels.  Another makes fabrics from kapok tree seeds.  The trees grow well in poor soil without needing much water.  <u>These</u> new fabrics produce less waste, last a long time, and break down easily.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 These가 가리키는 것은?

det.korean: These new fabrics는 앞에서 소개한 오렌지 껍질 소재(nanotechnology) + 카폭 나무 씨앗 직물 등 친환경 신소재 전체를 가리킨다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① 의류에 흔히 사용되는 기존 재료
→ 본문: 'Materials commonly used in clothing are not eco-friendly'
→ 기존 재료는 eco-friendly하지 않다고 서술. These new fabrics는 그 대안으로 소개된 '새로운' 직물이므로 기존 재료와 대비되는 개념.

❌ ② 농업 폐기물인 잎, 껍질, 씨앗
→ 본문: 'agricultural waste products like leaves, peels, and seeds'
→ 잎, 껍질, 씨앗은 직물을 만드는 원료(raw materials)이지 직물(fabrics) 자체가 아님. These는 그 원료로 '만들어진' 결과물을 지칭.

❌ ③ 재활용 섬유만을 지칭
→ 본문: 'recycled fibers and fibers extracted from agricultural waste products'
→ recycled fibers뿐 아니라 농업 폐기물에서 추출한 섬유까지 포함. '만을(only)'이라는 제한은 부적절.

✅ ④ 나노기술과 카폭 씨앗 등으로 만든 친환경 직물 ←정답
→ 본문: 'One company uses nanotechnology to make soft material from orange peels. Another makes fabrics from kapok tree seeds.'
→ These new fabrics = 오렌지 껍질 나노기술 소재 + 카폭 씨앗 직물 등 앞에서 구체적으로 소개한 친환경 신소재 전체.
det.tip: These/Those + 명사 = 앞에서 설명한 것들의 총칭. 구체적 사례들(오렌지 껍질, 카폭 씨앗)을 하나로 묶어 지칭.

ch: 나노기술과 카폭 씨앗 등으로 만든 친환경 직물

questions.passage: Jessi is a fashion blogger who loves unique, vibrant clothes.  But guess what?  She does not buy new clothes.  Instead, she buys them secondhand.  You may think secondhand clothes are old-fashioned, but by buying them, Jessi can try different styles.  She also does not get too attached to any style or brand because there is always another exciting outfit waiting to be discovered.  Jessi's clothing habits are not just about creating a style; they are about saving the Earth.  The reason is that her actions help reduce the production and consumption of clothes.
questions.stem:
다음 글을 읽고 아래 질문에 대한 답을 본문에서 찾아 문장을 완성하시오. (7단어, 영어로)
Q: Why does Jessi not get too attached to any style or brand?
→ Because there is always ________________________.

det.korean: 제시(Jessi)가 특정 스타일이나 브랜드에 집착하지 않는 이유: 항상 발견되기를 기다리는 또 다른 흥미로운 옷(another exciting outfit waiting to be discovered)이 있기 때문이다.
det.analysis:
원문: 'She also does not get too attached to any style or brand because there is always another exciting outfit waiting to be discovered.'

질문: Why does Jessi not get too attached to any style or brand?
→ because 이하가 이유를 설명.
→ there is always 뒤에 오는 것 = another exciting outfit waiting to be discovered (7단어)
→ '발견되기를 기다리는 또 다른 흥미로운 옷이 항상 있으므로' 집착하지 않는다.

찾기 유형이므로 passage에 정답이 노출되는 것은 정상.
det.tip: another exciting outfit waiting to be discovered: another(또 다른) + exciting(흥미로운) + outfit(옷) + waiting to be discovered(발견되기를 기다리는 = 현재분사구 후치수식).

questions.wa: another exciting outfit waiting to be discovered
accept: another exciting outfit waiting to be discovered

questions.passage: Circular fashion is inspired by the principles of a circular economy and sustainable development.  A circular economy is based on limiting waste, keeping resources and materials in use, and reusing them.  In a circular model, we make, use, and reuse materials for as long as possible to extract their maximum value.  Therefore, clothing and textiles are produced, used, and reused to minimize waste.  It is a renewable approach to reduce the fashion industry's environmental impact.  Circular fashion provides numerous benefits.  First, extending the lifespan of fibers significantly reduces textile waste, benefiting the environment.  Second, circular processes utilize chemicals and materials safe for human health and the environment.  This practice protects the environment and consumer health.  Third, materials are regenerated instead of being disposed of, which enables their long-term use.
questions.stem:
다음 글을 읽고 아래 질문에 대한 답을 본문에서 찾아 문장을 완성하시오. (10단어, 영어로)
Q: In a circular model, what do we do with materials and for what purpose?
→ We make, use, and reuse materials ________________________.

det.korean: 순환 모델에서는 재료의 최대 가치를 추출하기 위해 가능한 한 오래 재료를 만들고, 사용하고, 재사용한다.
det.analysis:
원문: 'In a circular model, we make, use, and reuse materials for as long as possible to extract their maximum value.'

질문: 순환 모델에서 재료를 어떻게, 무엇을 위해 사용하는가?
→ make, use, and reuse materials 뒤의 부분이 정답.
→ for as long as possible(가능한 한 오래) + to extract their maximum value(최대 가치 추출 목적)
→ 10단어: for as long as possible to extract their maximum value

구문 분석:
• for as long as possible: '가능한 한 오래' — as ~ as possible 구문
• to extract: '추출하기 위해' — 목적의 to부정사
• their maximum value: '재료의 최대 가치' — their = materials

찾기 유형이므로 passage에 정답 노출 정상.
det.tip: for as long as possible = 가능한 한 오래. to extract = 추출하기 위해 (목적의 to부정사). as ~ as possible = 가능한 한 ~하게.

questions.wa: for as long as possible to extract their maximum value
accept: for as long as possible to extract their maximum value

questions.passage:
Another key to making fashion sustainable is the consumer: us.  If we want the fashion industry to adopt more sustainable practices, we must care about how clothes come to us.  We should then demonstrate our concerns through what we buy.  The market, of course, will respond.  We can also reduce waste by discarding clothes responsibly.  To be specific, we should buy only what we need and pass clothing on to someone who will wear it or to a thrift shop when discarding it.

Circular fashion will not solve every problem in the fashion industry overnight.  However, small steps in the right direction are better than nothing.  Keeping things in the supply chain for as many cycles as possible is really important.
questions.stem:
다음 글을 읽고 아래 질문에 대한 답을 본문에서 찾아 문장을 완성하시오. (7단어, 영어로)
Q: What must consumers do if they want sustainable practices in fashion?
→ We must ________________________.

det.korean: 패션 산업이 지속 가능한 관행을 채택하려면 소비자는 옷이 어떻게 오는지에 관심을 가져야(care about how clothes come to us) 한다.
det.analysis:
원문: 'If we want the fashion industry to adopt more sustainable practices, we must care about how clothes come to us.'

질문: 소비자가 지속 가능한 패션을 원한다면 무엇을 해야 하는가?
→ we must 뒤의 행동이 정답.
→ care about how clothes come to us (7단어)

구문 분석:
• care about: ~에 관심을 갖다
• how clothes come to us: 간접의문문 (의문사 how + 주어 clothes + 동사 come)
• '옷이 어떻게 우리에게 오는지에 관심을 가져야 한다'

찾기 유형이므로 passage에 정답 노출 정상.
det.tip: care about = ~에 관심을 갖다. how + S + V = 간접의문문 (어떻게 ~하는지).

questions.wa: care about how clothes come to us
accept: care about how clothes come to us

questions.passage: In addition to these manufacturing techniques, technology will improve in such a way that it may become normal to produce clothes only when people order them.  This "make-to-order" method will cost more, but then less money will be spent on maintaining offline stores.  And 3D technology will enable people to ______ without trying them on in a store.  In the long run, innovation in production and sales will facilitate sustainable fashion and considerably reduce material waste and logistics emissions.

overlay.blank: see how clothes will fit online

questions.stem:
다음 빈칸에 주어진 조건에 맞게 영작하시오. (영어로)
"옷이 온라인에서 어떻게 맞을지 보다"
[조건] (1) clothes, fit, how, online, see, will을 모두 사용할 것
(2) 정확히 6단어로 쓸 것

det.korean: 3D 기술은 사람들이 매장에서 입어보지 않고도 옷이 온라인에서 어떻게 맞을지 볼 수 있게 해줄 것이다.
det.analysis:
원문: 'And 3D technology will enable people to see how clothes will fit online without trying them on in a store.'

조건 분석:
→ 주어진 단어: clothes, fit, how, online, see, will (6개)
→ 정확히 6단어로 작성
→ 한국어 의미: '옷이 온라인에서 어떻게 맞을지 보다'

구문 조립:
→ see(보다) + how(어떻게) + clothes(옷이) + will(~할 것인지) + fit(맞다) + online(온라인에서)
→ see how clothes will fit online (6단어)
→ 간접의문문: how + 주어(clothes) + 동사(will fit) 어순. 의문문 어순(how will clothes fit)이 아님에 주의.
det.tip: 간접의문문: see/know/wonder 뒤에는 의문사 + 주어 + 동사 어순. see how clothes will fit (O) / see how will clothes fit (X).

questions.wa: see how clothes will fit online
accept: see how clothes will fit online

questions.passage: Circular fashion will not solve every problem in the fashion industry overnight.  However, small steps in the right direction are better than nothing.  Keeping things in the supply chain for as many cycles as possible is really important.  ______ today, the fashion industry will gradually improve.  After all, nothing is more fashionable than saving the planet.

overlay.blank: By making small changes to our clothing habits

questions.stem:
다음 우리말에 맞도록 주어진 조건에 따라 영작하시오. (영어로)
"오늘날 우리의 옷 입는 습관에 작은 변화를 줌으로써"
[조건] (1) By, changes, clothing, habits, making, our, small, to를 모두 사용할 것
(2) 정확히 8단어로 쓸 것

det.korean: 오늘날 우리의 옷 입는 습관(clothing habits)에 작은 변화(small changes)를 줌으로써(By making) 패션 산업이 점진적으로 개선될 것이다.
det.analysis:
원문: 'By making small changes to our clothing habits today, the fashion industry will gradually improve.'

조건 분석:
→ 주어진 단어: By, changes, clothing, habits, making, our, small, to (8개)
→ 정확히 8단어로 작성
→ 한국어 의미: '오늘날 우리의 옷 입는 습관에 작은 변화를 줌으로써'

구문 조립:
→ By(~함으로써) + making(만들다/주다) + small changes(작은 변화를) + to(~에) + our(우리의) + clothing(옷 입는) + habits(습관)
→ By making small changes to our clothing habits (8단어)

문법 포인트:
→ By + 동명사(making): '~함으로써'라는 수단/방법 표현
→ make changes to ~: '~에 변화를 주다'라는 관용 표현
→ clothing habits: '옷 입는 습관' (clothing이 명사 habits를 수식하는 명사 형용사)
det.tip: By + ~ing = ~함으로써 (수단/방법). make changes to ~ = ~에 변화를 주다. clothing habits = 옷 입는 습관.

questions.wa: By making small changes to our clothing habits
accept: By making small changes to our clothing habits
